reviews.text: David and Dan are a class act. The install of my generator since it was a retro-fit was challenging and they used their expertise to perfection to work out the quirks. It's installed and working as indicated.
reviews.author: carlos H.

reviews.text: Absolute Professionalism, Integrity, and Ingenuity! These are the best words to describe my experience with David Pogue and Synergy Power Systems.
reviews.author: Kate M.

reviews.text: I first had an estimate done through Costco for a generator and did not like the vibe from the contractor they sent. I was referred to Dave by a friend and could not be happier with the price, service and installation.
reviews.author: Jim D.
